build_crf_transition_graph: build a bigram transition graph for a linear-chain CRF with a given number of classes
build_crf_potential_graph: build a unary potential graph mapping input features to output classes for a CRF model
build_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with random transition and potential weights for training
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a trained linear-chain CRF model using Viterbi decoding
compute_crf_loss: compute the negative log-likelihood loss for a CRF given input and target sequences
